title: operator-show-reaches-all-inbox-items
intention: cairn operator show <slug> should find the item regardless of whether it is a pending artifact, an idea, a ticket, or a question — everything the inbox lists should be viewable through the same command.
why: The inbox lists ideas by slug (e.g. 2026-08-30-a-device-that-knows-what-s-important), making them look like they should be viewable with cairn operator show artifact <slug>. But show artifact only searches pending_reviews() berths. The user gets 'no pending artifact matches' for an item the inbox just showed them. The inbox wrote a check the CLI cannot cash.
traces_to: Law 7 — errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces. The error message says 'no match' when the item exists in a different lane; a loud error would say 'not an artifact — found as idea: <path>'.
Akien 2026-09-01: tried cairn operator show artifact a-device-that-knows-what-s-important, got 'no pending artifact matches', filed as a bug.

falsifier.proves_green: cairn operator show <slug> resolves against all inbox item types — artifacts (berths), ideas, tickets, questions — and displays the content. A slug that matches an idea shows the idea. A slug that matches nothing says so across all lanes, not just one.
falsifier.proves_red: RED if: (1) the command still only searches berths; (2) an idea slug returns 'no match' when the idea file exists; (3) the lookup silently picks one lane when the slug matches in multiple (ambiguity must be announced).
falsifier.horizon: Small build — extend show_artifact (or add show_item) in operator_inbox/inbox.py to fall through ideas, tickets, questions when berths don't match.

watchme: none, because deterministic behavior, no drift to watch.
dependencies: cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py — show_artifact() is the function to extend.
CairnCommons/ideas/*.json — the idea files the lookup should reach.
CairnCommons/tickets/*.json — tickets should also be reachable.
CairnCommons/questions/*.json — questions should also be reachable.

chart_notes.orient: show_artifact() in inbox.py:462 searches pending_reviews() only. Ideas live at CairnCommons/ideas/<slug>.json. Tickets at CairnCommons/tickets/<hex-slug>.json. Questions at CairnCommons/questions/open-*.json. The fallthrough order: berths first (current behavior), then ideas by slug, then tickets by slug substring, then questions.
chart_notes.constrain: OUT: changing the inbox listing format. OUT: merging item types into one store. This is a read-path fix only — the command resolves what the inbox already lists.
chart_notes.validate: The tooth: cairn operator show a-device-that-knows-what-s-important returns the idea's content. cairn operator show <nonexistent> says 'no match in artifacts, ideas, tickets, or questions'.
